title: Holiday event server launching
summary: The TheySix event server was scheduled to launch on December 28 with Java and Bedrock support.
description: The first large event was announced with team-based gameplay, player applications and special rewards.

body.text: Applications were planned for the event, with players selected for available slots.
Four teams would compete to capture and hold the center of a large map.
Both Minecraft editions were supported, with players from multiple regions welcome to participate.
Top players could earn an exclusive Discord role with access to special community areas and event information.
